subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor Control UI math rendering now, and if so should it use an opt-in KaTeX/MathJax dependency/config path or a different rendering boundary?
rationale: Current main does not implement the feature, but the solution adds user-visible rendering policy plus dependency and sanitizer surface that ClawSweeper should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a hardened core implementation
options.body: Accept a default-safe Control UI math renderer after maintainer/security review of dependency, sanitizer, delimiter, streaming, and config behavior.

options.title: Keep the request but pause candidate PRs
options.body: Leave the issue open while maintainers defer core math rendering until a clearer product/security design is available.

options.title: Route to an extension design first
options.body: Ask for a plugin or UI extension API design if maintainers do not want this rendering behavior embedded directly in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a hardened core implementation
recommendation.body: Accept a default-safe Control UI math renderer after maintainer/security review of dependency, sanitizer, delimiter, streaming, and config behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Val Alexander is the strongest history signal for the current markdown-it renderer that would absorb or reject this feature shape.
